scope: ES writing-style documentation; Notion read only; no new application answer or career-strategy change

artifact_checks.method: Python check of coverage.json, source index rows, relative links, public-field allowlists, selected sensitive string patterns and git diff --check

original_text_copy_check.method: Compare whitespace-normalized source paragraphs with markup removed, at least 80 characters, against new Markdown documents. Short generic language and abstract constructions are retained; this is not an exhaustive semantic disclosure detector.

privacy_review: Manual review of new documentation and diffs: source links, company/record labels, abstract style rules only; no detailed ES answer, private selection message, employer prompt image or company access properties copied.

git.remote_verification: Performed after commit and push; SHA and result reported in final chat, outside this pre-commit artifact.

limitations: Coverage is limited to accessible live Notion company pages and returned ES rows.
Notion submission status is not independent evidence of external submission.
Qualitative writing-style analysis; not a statistical authorship model.
Authorship/edit history and all scientific or employer claims inside old ES were not independently audited.
